messages.subject: Output of aroma affymetrix analysis
parts:
Hello,

I did RMA background correction, normalization and then RLE and NUSE.
I'm wondering if there are any output files other than the two images
created using RLE and NUSE.

I was following this tutorial:
http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/human-exon-array-analysis

Thanks for the help

messages.author: 1ff63ac4948de366
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Output of aroma affymetrix analysis
parts:
Hi Zaid.

Reading on at that page, it says:

-------------
To extract the estimates (transcript or probeset) use either
extractMatrix() or extractDataFrame() on the ChipEffectSet that
corresponds to the plm object:


cesTr <- getChipEffectSet(plmTr)
trFit <- extractDataFrame(cesTr, units=1:3, addNames=TRUE)
-------------

Hope that helps.
Mark
